svg.text: aka Lp_Zombie · IT security · Gamer · Selfhoster · Manga reader
I'm an IT specialist working at Serviceware SE, where I handle the security of the
IT systems to ensure smooth operations. Off the clock, I run a small fleet of
V-servers, Raspberry Pis, and a Synology NAS hosting web services and other
playground projects. I also enjoy gaming, especially roguelike games, and reading
manga, of which I have an extensive collection that I'm proud of.
